title: The Complete Guide to Choosing Professional Tax Software
description: Evaluate and select the best professional tax software for tax preparers. Learn about filing diagnostic tools, bank enrollment models, and remote user console options.
author: The Sector Editorial
content:
Selecting the right professional tax software for tax preparers is one of the most critical decisions you will make for your business. The right software does more than submit forms—it handles diagnostic reviews, automates ERO tracking, and integrates bank products seamlessly.

### Why Professional Tax Software Matters

Unlike individual consumer software, professional tax software offers unlimited multi-site licenses, e-filing consoles for remote teams, and direct access to banking portals for refund advances. If you are an ERO or Service Bureau operator, you need centralized management consoles to inspect returns prepped by junior agents before e-filing.

### 3 Key Features to Look For

1. **IRS Compliance Diagnostics**: The platform must run validation scans to identify missing signatures, invalid dependent details, or compliance discrepancies before transmitting.
2. **Direct Bank Product Enrollment**: Ensure you can offer refund settlement options where tax preparation fees are auto-deducted, eliminating payment friction with clients.
3. **Scalable Site Consoles**: If your tax business grows, you will need remote preparer logins that keep client records securely isolated.

title: How to Become an ERO: IRS EFIN Approval Checklist
description: A step-by-step training guide on how to become an ERO (Electronic Return Originator). Learn about IRS e-Services, fingerprint cards, and ID.me verification.
author: Compliance Advisors
content:
Transitioning from preparer to firm owner requires getting your EFIN. Learning how to become an ERO is the first operational step to secure financial independence, allowing you to stop splitting fees and start offering bank products directly.

### The 5-Step ERO Roadmap

1. **IRS e-Services Registration**: Create a secure account on the IRS portal to begin the ERO application process.
2. **ID.me Verification**: Authenticate your credentials with the IRS's identity partner. This requires facial scanning and document uploads.
3. **Digital Fingerprinting**: Submit digital fingerprint records for FBI background checks. Locate certified local identity partners to avoid processing delays.
4. **Office Security Audit**: Establish internal cybersecurity policies (WISP compliance) and choose compliant physical setups.
5. **EFIN Software Link**: Link your approved EFIN inside your professional tax software to activate direct e-filing operations.

title: How to Start a Service Bureau: Structure & Pricing Blueprint
description: Learn how to start a service bureau, distribute professional tax software, and scale recurring license revenue under your own brand.
author: Service Bureau Mentors
content:
Preparing returns is a great active income model, but to build a business that outlasts tax season, you must learn to scale. Starting a Service Bureau allows you to distribute software licenses, train remote preparers, and collect recurring fees.

### The Service Bureau Advantage

By licensing software, you transition from a service provider to an infrastructure provider. You earn revenue from software setup charges, document portal access, and compliance review splits. This creates high-margin recurring income that flows throughout the year.

### Critical Operations to Master

* **Sub-Site Consoles**: Track e-file volume for each office under your brand.
* **Compliance Auditing**: Routinely audit sub-site EFIN filings to protect your service bureau status.
* **Team Training**: Host weekly tech walkthroughs to keep remote preparers aligned.
